proof_requests: Clear photo of the body's model badge (e.g. 'D810') and serial number plate.
Clear photo of the lens barrel showing brand, focal length, and aperture markings.
Screenshot of shutter count from EXIF or counter app.
Close-up photos of front/rear lens elements with cap off, in good light.
Photo of battery and charger together with the camera.
Short video showing camera powering on and taking a test shot.
response.reason: The listed comparables are mostly single lenses (and one unspecified Canon body) with different mounts and specs, none matching a complete Nikon D810 body plus 24-70mm lens kit, so no defensible cheapest/dearest pick exists for this item as seen.
